items.title: File NYC Business Corporation Tax return
items.authority: NYC Department of Finance
items.description: C and S corporations doing business in New York City file NYC-2 / NYC-4S (or NYC-3L for general corporations) and pay the tax.

items.title: File NYC Unincorporated Business Tax (UBT) return
items.authority: NYC Department of Finance
items.description: Sole proprietors, partnerships and LLCs taxed as such that carry on a business in New York City file NYC-202 / NYC-204 (4% rate, with credits for some owners).

items.title: Provide NYC Earned Safe and Sick Time
items.authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
items.description: Employers must provide safe and sick leave, post the required notice and give employees written policy.

items.title: Renew San Francisco Business Registration Certificate
items.authority: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector
items.description: Every business operating in San Francisco must register and renew annually; fee depends on gross receipts.

items.title: File San Francisco gross receipts tax return
items.authority: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector
items.description: Businesses over the small-business exemption threshold file the annual gross receipts tax return.

items.title: File San Francisco payroll expense tax return
items.authority: San Francisco Office of the Treasurer & Tax Collector
items.description: Payroll expense tax applies to businesses whose San Francisco payroll exceeds the exclusion amount.

items.title: Obtain and renew Los Angeles Business Tax Registration Certificate
items.authority: Los Angeles Office of Finance
items.description: Businesses operating in the City of Los Angeles register for the business tax and renew annually; tax is based on gross receipts and business class.

items.title: Obtain Chicago business license
items.authority: Chicago Department of Business Affairs and Consumer Protection (BACP)
items.description: Most Chicago businesses need a license for their activity and location, with zoning and inspection sign-off where applicable.

items.title: Provide Chicago Paid Leave and Paid Sick and Safe Leave
items.authority: Chicago Department of Business Affairs and Consumer Protection (BACP)
items.description: Employers covered by the Chicago Paid Leave and Paid Sick and Safe Leave Ordinance must provide leave, post notice and keep records.

items.title: Obtain Seattle business license tax certificate and file B&O tax
items.authority: Seattle Department of Finance and Administrative Services
items.description: Seattle requires a business license tax certificate (via the state Business Licensing Service) and a Seattle B&O tax return when taxable revenue exceeds the threshold.

items.title: File Portland and Multnomah County business income taxes
items.authority: City of Portland Revenue Division
items.description: Businesses with Portland-source income file the City Business License Tax and Multnomah County Business Income Tax through the Revenue Division; Metro supportive housing and Preschool for All taxes apply to higher-income owners.

items.title: Obtain Philadelphia Commercial Activity License
items.authority: Philadelphia Department of Revenue
items.description: Free license required for any business operating in Philadelphia; required before other city licenses.

items.title: File Philadelphia Business Income & Receipts Tax (BIRT)
items.authority: Philadelphia Department of Revenue
items.description: Annual tax on gross receipts and net income for entities doing business in Philadelphia.

items.title: Withhold and remit Philadelphia Wage Tax
items.authority: Philadelphia Department of Revenue
items.description: Employers withhold the city wage tax from employees and remit it with the quarterly reconciliation.

items.title: Obtain Denver sales and use tax license
items.authority: Denver Department of Finance, Treasury Division
items.description: Denver is a home-rule city and administers its own sales and use tax separately from the state.

items.title: Withhold and remit Denver Occupational Privilege Tax (OPT)
items.authority: Denver Department of Finance, Treasury Division
items.description: Employers and employees pay a monthly occupational privilege tax for work performed in Denver.

items.title: Obtain and renew San Diego Business Tax Certificate
items.authority: City of San Diego Office of the City Treasurer
items.description: Every business operating in the City of San Diego, including home-based and self-employed businesses, needs a Business Tax Certificate for each business location; the annual tax depends on headcount.

items.title: Register for and renew San José Business Tax Certificate
items.authority: City of San José Finance Department, Business Tax Registration
items.description: Businesses operating in San José register within 90 days of starting and renew the business tax annually, due the 15th of the month the business started.
items.deadline: 15th of the month the business started

items.title: Register for and renew Oakland Business Tax Certificate
items.authority: City of Oakland Finance Department, Business Tax Office
items.description: Anyone conducting business in Oakland registers and pays the annual business tax (rates vary by business class on gross receipts); certificates expire December 31.

items.title: File Boston business certificate (DBA) with the City Clerk
items.authority: City of Boston City Clerk
items.description: Businesses operating under a trade name file a business certificate with the City Clerk and renew it every four years; corporations and LLCs must first be registered with the Secretary of the Commonwealth.

items.title: Obtain and renew Atlanta Business Occupational Tax Certificate
items.authority: City of Atlanta Office of Revenue
items.description: Businesses operating in Atlanta hold an occupational tax certificate, renewed annually through the city's online portal; certificates expire December 31.

items.title: Obtain and renew City of Miami Business Tax Receipt
items.authority: City of Miami
items.description: Businesses located in the City of Miami need a city business tax receipt; receipts expire September 30 each year.

items.title: Obtain and renew Miami-Dade County Local Business Tax Receipt
items.authority: Miami-Dade County Tax Collector
items.description: Businesses within a municipality must hold both the city and the county local business tax receipt; the tax year runs October 1 – September 30.

items.title: Register for and withhold Detroit city income tax
items.authority: City of Detroit Income Tax Division / Michigan Department of Treasury
items.description: Employers with a location in Detroit or doing business there register with the city, withhold city income tax monthly or quarterly, and file the annual reconciliation.

items.title: File Detroit corporate or partnership income tax return
items.authority: Michigan Department of Treasury (for the City of Detroit)
items.description: Corporations and partnerships doing business in Detroit file the city return, which the Michigan Department of Treasury has processed since 2017.

items.title: File Columbus municipal net profit tax return
items.authority: City of Columbus Income Tax Division (City Auditor)
items.description: Businesses (sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations) with activity in Columbus file the city's annual business net profit return; some businesses may elect to file through the Ohio Department of Taxation.

items.title: Withhold and remit Columbus municipal income tax
items.authority: City of Columbus Income Tax Division (City Auditor)
items.description: Employers withhold municipal income tax on wages for work performed in Columbus.

items.title: File Cleveland municipal net profit return (CCA)
items.authority: Central Collection Agency (CCA)
items.description: C and S corporations, partnerships and LLCs doing business in Cleveland file the net profit return with the Central Collection Agency; due 105 days after fiscal year end.

items.title: Withhold and remit Cleveland municipal income tax (CCA)
items.authority: Central Collection Agency (CCA)
items.description: Employers withhold and remit municipal income tax through the Central Collection Agency using the employer EIN.

items.title: File Cincinnati business income tax return
items.authority: City of Cincinnati Income Tax Division
items.description: Businesses engaged in Cincinnati (rental property, sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations) file the business net profit return at the city's 1.8% rate.

items.title: Withhold and remit Cincinnati income tax
items.authority: City of Cincinnati Income Tax Division
items.description: Employers register for and remit withholding for employees working in Cincinnati.

items.title: Register for Pittsburgh payroll expense tax and local services tax
items.authority: City of Pittsburgh Department of Finance
items.description: Employers with employees working in Pittsburgh register for the payroll expense tax and withhold the local services tax per employee.

items.title: File Louisville Metro occupational license tax net profits return (OL-3)
items.authority: Louisville Metro Revenue Commission
items.description: Entities with business nexus in Louisville/Jefferson County pay the occupational license tax (2.2% resident rate) on net profits; due the 15th day of the 4th month after fiscal year end.

items.title: Register for and withhold Louisville occupational license tax (W-1)
items.authority: Louisville Metro Revenue Commission
items.description: Employers register with the Revenue Commission and withhold occupational license tax from employee compensation.

items.title: Obtain and renew Kansas City business license
items.authority: City of Kansas City, Missouri Finance Department
items.description: New businesses register (Form RD-100) and file the business license (Form RD-105) within 60 days of opening, renewing by March 1 each year; the fee depends on prior-year gross receipts.

items.title: File Kansas City earnings and profits tax return (RD-108)
items.authority: City of Kansas City, Missouri Finance Department
items.description: Businesses pay the 1% tax on net profits (return due April 15, even in a loss year) while the earnings tax remains in effect.

items.title: Withhold and remit Kansas City earnings tax (RD-110)
items.authority: City of Kansas City, Missouri Finance Department
items.description: Employers withhold the 1% earnings tax for employees who live or work in the city and file the quarterly return.

items.title: File St. Louis business earnings tax return
items.authority: City of St. Louis Collector of Revenue, Earnings Tax Department
items.description: Businesses located in or working in the City of St. Louis pay a 1% tax on business earnings; account application Form E-9; return due April 15 (calendar year).

items.title: File St. Louis payroll expense tax and earnings tax withholding (P-10/W-10)
items.authority: City of St. Louis Collector of Revenue, Earnings Tax Department
items.description: Employers pay the 0.5% payroll expense tax and withhold earnings tax for employees working in the city, filing quarterly.

items.title: Obtain and renew Maryland trader's license from the Baltimore City Clerk of the Circuit Court
items.authority: Clerk of the Circuit Court for Baltimore City
items.description: Retail and wholesale sellers need a trader's license based on inventory value; the license year runs May 1 – April 30 with renewals due by May 31.

items.title: Obtain and renew New Orleans occupational license
items.authority: City of New Orleans Safety and Permits (zoning review) and Bureau of Revenue
items.description: Any business in Orleans Parish needs an occupational license, with zoning approval first and fees set by business type and gross sales; licenses expire December 31.

items.title: Obtain City of Las Vegas business license
items.authority: City of Las Vegas Business Licensing (with Clark County for unincorporated areas)
items.description: Businesses located in the City of Las Vegas need a city business license in addition to the Nevada state business license; businesses outside city limits use Clark County.

items.title: File fictitious firm name with the Clark County Clerk
items.authority: Clark County Clerk
items.description: Businesses operating under a name other than the owner's or entity's legal name file a fictitious firm name with the Clark County Clerk.

items.title: Obtain City of Phoenix transaction privilege (sales) tax license
items.authority: City of Phoenix Finance Department, Tax Compliance and Education
items.description: Businesses making taxable sales within Phoenix hold a city privilege tax license and report city TPT in addition to the state TPT; retail tax is based on the seller's location.
